title: Brush tool produces a square/rectangular head instead of a round brush tip
description:
USER-REPORTED BUG (drawing-tool fidelity).

REPRO
1. Select the Brush tool (B).
2. Draw a single dab (click / very short drag) and a normal stroke.
3. Observe: the stroke ENDS and the dab HEAD are square/rectangular, not round. A single click/dab produces nothing or a small rectangle, not a circle.

ROOT CAUSE (stored geometry, not a render-time cap setting)
- File: packages/authoring-ui/src/StageArea.tsx, function brushPointsToShape() lines 269-304.
- The brush builds a FILLED closed polygon by sweeping a thick ribbon along the drag polyline: for each sample point it offsets +/- half the brush size PERPENDICULAR to the local tangent (lines 280-293), collecting a 'forward' edge and a 'backward' edge, then closes the loop with straight LINE segments (allPoints, lines 296-302, segments all type:'line', closed:true).
- There is NO round-cap geometry at the start or end of the ribbon: the last forward point is joined to the last backward point by a flat straight line across the ribbon width => BUTT/SQUARE ends. The joins between segments are also mitered/straight, not round.
- A single dab is dropped entirely: line 274 returns an empty shape when points.length < 2 (and the finalize path at line 3069 requires >= 2 points). A near-zero-length stroke yields a thin rectangle.
- So the 'square head' is baked into the stored Shape path geometry; it is NOT a LINESTYLE2 cap setting (the brush emits a FILL, not a stroke), so there is no EndCap/StartCap to flip. Note: per CLAUDE.md LINESTYLE2 notes, round vs butt/square caps only apply to STROKE-based tools (pencil/ink); the brush is fill-based and must build round nib geometry itself.

EXPECTED vs ACTUAL
- Expected (Flash 8 default): round brush tip. A single dab is a CIRCLE of diameter brushSize; a stroke is the ribbon with ROUNDED ends (semicircle caps) and rounded joins.
- Actual: square/rectangular ends, no dab on single click.

REGRESSION VERDICT
- LONG-STANDING. brushPointsToShape has been unchanged since the initial commit (4b4e4cf 'initial progress') per git log -L. The recent ToolsPanel re-theme is styling only and does not touch brush geometry.

FIX DIRECTION
- Build a ROUND nib: (a) for a single dab (points.length < 2), emit a circle (4 cubic/quad arcs) of diameter brushSize centered on the point; (b) for a stroke, cap each end of the swept ribbon with a semicircular arc (curve segments) instead of a straight cross-line, and round the corner joins. Equivalent: union of circles stamped along the path. Keep it as stored fill geometry so it round-trips and compiles correctly.

ACCEPTANCE
- A unit test asserting a brush dab's produced Shape geometry is ROUND: e.g. a single-point dab yields a circular path (curve segments / radius ~= brushSize/2, not 4 straight rectangle corners), and a straight stroke's end is bounded by a semicircle (curve segments) rather than a flat line. (e2e/Ruffle optional and out of scope here.)
